wins.label: Record 2023 revenue and net income
wins.evidence: reported record revenue and net income despite some notable significant items

wins.label: Strong capital generation and ROTCE
wins.evidence: delivered an ROTCE of 21% for full year and 15% CET1 ratio, up 70 basis points

wins.label: Robust AWM net inflows
wins.evidence: record client asset net inflows of $489 billion for the year, AUM of $3.4 trillion and client assets of $5 trillion both up 24%

wins.label: Strong card and consumer growth
wins.evidence: total debit and credit card spend was up 7% year-on-year, card outstandings up 14%, 2 million net new checking accounts in 2023

wins.label: Investment Banking momentum
wins.evidence: Investment Banking revenue of $1.6 billion was up 13% year-on-year, ranked #1 with wallet share of 8.8%, starting year with healthy pipeline

risks.label: Significant NII decline expected in 2024
risks.evidence: $94 billion exit rate and full year guidance of $88 billion implies meaningful sequential quarterly declines throughout 2024

risks.label: Commercial real estate deterioration
risks.evidence: deterioration in commercial real estate valuations in the commercial bank driving net reserve build of $142 million

risks.label: Deposit balance pressure
risks.evidence: average deposits down 6% year-on-year in Commercial Bank, expect balances to be very modestly down from current levels in 2024

risks.label: Elevated economic and geopolitical uncertainties
risks.evidence: despite expected dissipation of 2023 tailwinds and presence of significant economic and geopolitical uncertainties

risks.label: Regulatory uncertainty on capital rules
risks.evidence: uncertainty about the finalization of the rules and Basel III end game requirements limiting buyback pace to modest $2 billion quarterly
